prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic black-and-white manga page that turns an original idol girl into the protagonist of a serialized manga chapter, with cinematic paneling, Japanese shojo manga linework, and a powerful quote scene.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, roughly 4:5 aspect ratio, high-resolution monochrome with screentones, ink hatching, glossy highlights, thick white panel gutters, and slightly tilted dynamic panels.

Layout: Use exactly 5 discrete panels. Panel 1 is a small upper-left close-up of a hand tightly gripping a backstage pass on a lanyard. Panel 2 is a large upper-right establishing shot of an empty theater stage from backstage, with curtains, rigging, spotlights, microphone stand, stage floor reflections, and the manga title overlaid. Panel 3 is a narrow middle-left close-up of one sparkling eye filled with determination. Panel 4 is the large main lower panel showing the heroine entering from behind a curtain, smiling confidently toward the viewer. Panel 5 is a tall oval speech balloon on the lower-right side containing the heroine’s quote.

Subject details: The protagonist is a cute young idol heroine with long pale twin tails with ribbons, braids, and small flower hairpins, huge sparkling eyes with light pink-tinted irises as the only subtle color accent, a bright determined smile, and delicate earrings. She wears a frilly black-and-white idol stage dress with a large bow, lace cuffs, layered skirt, corset-like bodice, chains, ribbons, and sparkling star details. Her pose is energetic and story-defining: one hand clutches near her chest while the other pulls aside a backstage curtain, as if stepping onto the stage for a decisive performance.

Text content: Include Japanese manga text. On the backstage pass, write “STAGE PASS”, “No. 17”, and “Back Stage”. On the theater-stage title panel, write the ornate title 星屑の声は誰のために光る？ and below it “第17話・夜明けを指名するのは私”. Add hand-drawn sound effects near the pass, eye, and curtain, such as “ぎゅっ”, “ドクン”, and “すっ”. In the speech balloon, write the vertical quote 「可愛いだけで勝てるなら、私はここまで本気になってない。」.

Visual style: Premium serialized shojo manga opening page, extremely detailed hair strands, luminous eyes, expressive ink lines, dramatic lighting, soft sparkles, star motifs, halftone gradients, reflective stage blacks, ornate typography, emotional idol-drama atmosphere, polished professional manga composition.

Constraints: Keep the page monochrome except for the faint pink eye accents. Use exactly 5 panels and exactly 1 speech balloon. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements.

promptZh:
目标：创作一页充满戏剧性的黑白漫画，将 一位原创偶像少女 打造为连载漫画章节的主角，并呈现电影感的分镜、日式少女漫画线条以及震撼的台词场景。

画布：竖版漫画页面，比例约为 4:5，高分辨率单色，包含网点纸效果、墨水排线、高光、加粗的白色分镜边框以及略微倾斜的动态分镜。

布局：使用 5 个独立分镜。分镜 1 为左上角特写，展示一只手紧紧抓着挂绳上的后台通行证。分镜 2 为右上角大景，展示从后台望向空荡剧场舞台的画面，包含幕布、吊杆、聚光灯、麦克风架、舞台地面反光，并叠加漫画标题。分镜 3 为左侧中间的窄条特写，展示一只充满决心的闪亮眼眸。分镜 4 为下方的大型主分镜，展示女主从幕布后走出，自信地对着观众微笑。分镜 5 为右下角的一个高椭圆形对话气泡，包含女主的台词。

主体细节：主角是一位可爱的年轻偶像，拥有 带有丝带、编发和小花发夹的长款浅色双马尾，巨大的闪亮眼眸，虹膜带有淡淡的粉色调作为唯一的色彩点缀，笑容明亮坚定，佩戴精致的耳环。她身穿 带有大蝴蝶结、蕾丝袖口、多层裙摆、紧身胸衣式上衣、链条、丝带和闪亮星星装饰的黑白荷叶边偶像舞台装。她的姿势充满活力且具有故事性：一只手紧贴胸口，另一只手拉开后台幕布，仿佛正要踏上舞台进行一场决定性的演出。

文字内容：包含日文漫画文字。在后台通行证上写上“STAGE PASS”、“No. 17”和“Back Stage”。在剧场舞台标题分镜中，写上华丽的标题 星屑の声は誰のために光る？，下方写上“第17話・夜明けを指名するのは私”。在通行证、眼睛和幕布附近添加手绘拟声词，例如“ぎゅっ”、“ドクン”和“すっ”。在对话气泡中，写上竖排台词 「可愛いだけで勝てるなら、私はここまで本気になってない。」。

视觉风格：高级连载少女漫画开篇页，极具细节的发丝、明亮的眼睛、富有表现力的墨线、戏剧性的光影、柔和的闪光、星星元素、网点渐变、舞台黑色的反光、华丽的排版、充满情感的偶像剧氛围，以及专业精良的漫画构图。

限制：除眼睛处淡淡的粉色点缀外，页面保持单色。使用 5 个分镜和 1 个对话气泡。不要添加额外角色、Logo、水印或现代 UI 元素。
